Luna Mic is a lightweight Windows microphone processor with local noise removal,
voice shaping, a noise gate, compression and headphone monitoring.

The Windows x64 ZIP includes the app and the original VB-CABLE setup. Luna Mic
offers setup when the cable is missing and routes processed voice through it.
VB-CABLE is donationware by VB-Audio; its original license and notices are included.

This is an early release. Audio quality depends on the microphone and selected
method. Noise-removal methods currently require a 48 kHz input.
